nom: Peach Slices Redness Relief Soothing Serum

avis.texte: This product and along with azelaic acid serum together helps reduce the redness. The serums is best product from this line. Worth buying both.
Wonderful serum for my Rosacea prone skin It never irritates my skin or left me with flare ups just calming and soothing Highly recommended

I've been struggling with overly reactive skin and possibly a coconut allergy in skin care. I found this line and have been using it daily. This serum is amazing. It is so soothing and hydrating and absorbs quickly. If I only used one serum, it would be this one. I used it as my main serum for a while and it did wonders for my sensitive skin. I've now been using it in combination with the Azelaic Acid serum and the Redness Relief moisturizer and they are healing my skin. I'm in love!
This is my go to serum that keeps the hot red patches calm and out of sight! It is so gentle and calms my flare ups immediately! I love this soothing serum!
I was really excited to try this product after reading reviews here and online. It worked okay with reducing the redness in my cheeks, but I broke out every time I used the product.

My skin was doing really well with the routine I had before this, I'm really mad I messed it up. I just wanted to add a serum. My redness that had previously been at bay has come back + I'm now broke out. Skip this if you have sensitive skin :\

avis.titre: Reduces redness for the right price
avis.texte: This serum is a lightweight redness reducer with a bit of hydration for me. By the time all my skincare settles and absorbs, my face is less red. And I find it works like Glow Recipe Avocado Serum, but at half the cost.

I have very sensitive fair skin that gets red very easily. This gel serum is so lovely! It is cooling and the redness is toned down quickly. The gel smooths over fine lines and blurs imperfections. Can't recommend enough!
Lovely slick consistency that sinks in quickly. It gives a nice glassy sheen and calms skin.

I honestly dont feel like this does much. I would only recommend to VERY sensitive skin people that cant use anything else on their skins. I have type 1 rosacea and this didn't irritate my skin but i didnt notice any benefit to keep using it.
This item Redness Relief along with the other Redness relief product is great on my skin. I have red sensitive skin and this has really helped it alot.

avis.titre: Calms Under Eye and Face Redness!!
avis.texte: The best product is Redness Relief Serum. I have started having redness and swelling under my eyes, especially the right one. Plus eczema on my nose, cheeks and above my lip too. This serum is amazing! I've tried everything, Rx and expensive. This serum works!
I absolutely love this product! I have a lot of redness but since using this the redness is almost gone!
I wouldn't say it did anything for my redness but it didn't seem to irritate my skin either.

I've used this along with the azelaic acid product and the snail rescue serum for about 4 months and I'm pretty satisfied with them! I have rosacea and this routine has given my skin the best results I've had in a long time. I've used a lot of products, some much pricier than these, and nothing comes close.
it reduced redness on my cheeks but been using for months and i still slightly have sone redness

THE ABSOLUTE BEST product for dry, sensitive skin that is plagued with redness. My rosacea is under control thanks to this product! It was such a dramatic change that my husband—who has severe rosacea but not desire for a skincare routine—just had to try it and LOVES it.
I love this serum! The price is great and I've noticed a reduction in the amount of redness I see.

avis.titre: Face broke out in painful red welps
avis.texte: I used this product by itself on my freshly washed face and fell asleep. Woke up to swollen, dry, red welps on my face. Very painful would not recommend, it was harsh on my skin.

I have rosacea so maybe this product isn't meant for that. I've used it for a month and don't see much improvement in the redness. It does feel hydrated but it just isn't doing what it's advertised to do for me.

avis.titre: I think it is already helping my red cheeks
avis.texte: After just a week I feel the redness on my cheeks and nose has improved quite a bit. I know it takes time but I notice mostly in the mornings that my face isn't as red as it usually is. Wish I could help out more as to what the problem is...it's mostly a lot of tiny broken capillaries in one place that I honestly think was caused by extreme hot flashes in my face and neck! But either way this product is affordable and does seem to have helped after just a week or so.

Let's face it, we all deal with breakouts and unfortunately there's no way to permanently get rid of that. Thankfully, their redness relief does help with that. It's gentle on my skin and i definitely notice a bit of a difference if I put this over a pimple. I have very fair skin so in general, this helps with a lot of redness on my face.

This product works well to reduce redness and skin sensitivity. Purchased for my husband after complaints of redness and sensitivity and he couldn't fine a product that worked consistently. After making the switch there has been no turning back. Peach and Lily has not disappointed on anything thus far.

avis.titre: Did not work for my teenage son
avis.texte: I was high hopes when a sales lady recommend this for my son's redness from acne. Three weeks later and doesn't seem to work at all. Face still red, and not calming. Derma is the way to go!

This one doesn't work for me. All this has served to do is make my face burn around my sensitive areas (near my hairline, around my lip line, nostrils and under my eyes (I don't put it right on my bottom lids, I stop around the orbital socket).
Got this to help moisturizer skin & my target areas instead it dried it out so much so it peeled off around my mouth.

avis.titre: I'm gonna have to give it a no.
avis.texte: I bought this since my skin gets super red and it literally did nothing. It just felt like a serum with no effects. It did make my makeup very smooth as it did hydrate my face, but not worth. I brokeout very badly after using for a solid week. If you have sensitive skin I wouldn't reccomend.
My redness is so much better! This works perfect on my sensitive skin! I've also seen a big difference in my occasional breakouts
Just started using it and my redness seem more calm. If anything, it really makes my skin look smoother!
Has become my new holy grail whenever i overdo it with acids or have some irritation on my face. Hydrating, no scent, and absorbs into the skin immediately.
I love the consistency of the serum and how it makes my skin feel, but it doesn't seem to actually help with redness.

avis.titre: Helps redness but can cause oiliness
avis.texte: This serum definitely helps with redness around my nose and forehead, but it can also make those areas appear more oily than usual. Probably best for someone with more dry skin. I will likely try the azelaic acid serum next.

avis.titre: I guess it's not for me
avis.texte: I was hoping this would work but I did not see any change in my redness. It went on easy but after a few minutes my face would feel sticky. Unfortunately this was not soothing whatsoever.

It felt super soothing and clean to put on your face. But unfortunately (not sure if it was this or the cleanser) there was some irritation and breakouts after using this for a while and I saw no decrease in redness.

I've been using this serum for a few weeks now. It's strange, some days it works and some days it does nothing. It's mildly burned a few times, but I may have used an exfoliating face scrub beforehand (don't remember). Will prob try something else next

I got the matcha pudding as my birthday reward from Ulta and after using for two days I went back to get more products from peach and lily. I'm obsessed! My skin feels so clean and light weight after using these products.
Initially it worked ok. Not amazing, but some minor improvement. Within a week I had more redness and then a rash. Maybe too harsh for my sensitive skin.

I have perioral dermatitis and even after a flare up heals I can have leftover redness for months. I put this on a red patch around my nose in the Ulta parking lot and halfway home the redness was already way better. Now a couple of hours later it's almost completely gone!
Been using this for 1 week, and it seems to work like it says. It helps with any type of redness I might have. Well definitely buy again abd try more in this line.
Favorite serum for when i go a little overboard with the acids! Doesnt break me out or cause any irritation. Highly recommend

avis.titre: Allergic Reaction Caused Skin to Burn
avis.texte: I have incredibly sensitive skin and this immediately caused my skin to burn. I'm assuming it's an allergy to some ingredient(s) in this. I only used it once but it caused more redness, itchiness and dry patches. Returned.

I've had this product for about a month and a half and was a little skeptical on how good it would work on my redness. After trying it out I can definitely say the coverage of this product works! I haven't had any breakouts using this product (I have sensitive skin) and it does what it is supposed to do!

Really soothing formula that doesn't break me out and leaves skin moisturized and glowy. I like how this product is so affordable but still gets the job done. I have rosacea and keeping my redness under control is something I struggled with for a long time but this line helps a lot. The serum is lightweight and perfect for layering under moisturizer and smells great too.

I wasn't sure if this would affect my rosacea and skin that's going through a Tret treatment, but it surprisingly worked to help calm my skin. And trust me when I say that I have sensitive skin. I recommend this to anyone who is looking for a well made Korean skincare product!
So far I like the results and it soothes my redness immediately for the most part, but I still need to use it longer!
I mostly use the snail rescue line from peach slices but I like this serum better than the snail rescue serum. I have acne prone skin and this helps keep it hydrated and calm.

This is a nice light-weight serum. It isn't oily and doesn't feel like it leaves any residue behind. This in combination with the redness relief cleanser have really helped clean my skin with good reduction of redness.

After using this product, my face became really red, itchy, and irritated. It worked very well for some of my friends who tried it, but not at all for me. Just make sure to read the label clearly for ingredients that might give you a reaction.
This product really does reduse the redness on my face. It really helps before putting in my makeup. It really gives full coverage. My skin feels like it's even.

I have noticed a slight decrease in redness but it's hard to measure with the cold and allergies making my face flush all the time haha. I had no irritation, the packaging is adorable, and the serum easily absorbs into my skin without leaving a film. My hormonal acne still flares up every now and then but I see significantly less redness with my breakouts. A very cute product that I would recommend for warmer weather when you see less allergy redness, so you can really appreciate the product.

I usually have redness around my nose due to allergies and repeated blowing of my nose. This helps somewhat but I can't really tell. I don't get breakouts much but I do enjoy the soothing coverage aspect of this serum. I can't tell how good it is compared to my other serums tho so I don't know if I'll buy again.

I have only been using this product for a few weeks off and on but i can tell it has helped with my redness. I do use it alone with the other redness relief peace slices products. it is very silky and i like that!

I've only had the chance to use this once, and I didn't notice a ton of redness reduction when I did. However, I am looking forward to trying it again. It didn't cause any reactions, irritation, or breakouts, so that's a good sign!
Very smooth and a little goes a long way. Refreshing dries fast

I have Rosacea, and have been using this product for a month. This covers the redness so well that I no longer need to apply my full coverage foundation! I just apply this over my sunscreen, and I'm good to go. This has great coverage, without making your skin look grey/pasty. It does make your face look shiny/glowy, but if that ever bothers me, I'll just add a little powder. I hope they do not ever change the formula, because this is perfect. And I hope they continue selling this indefinitely! It's become a necessity in my Rosacea arsenal!

I have really sensitive skin, easily irritated by a lot of products. I used another product that totally broke me out and caused a lot of sensitivity, so I tried this one out as a means of correcting my mistake. It has definitely worked. It helped calm my breakouts and is super gentle on my skin. It applies really smoothly, I use it in both the AM and PM as it is really light and smooth serum. My spots caused by the other product have disappeared quickly and I've even noticed some added brightness. If you have really sensitive skin that is also dry but easily clogged, I think this is a great product, especially for the price point.

Redness Relief, helps tone down the redness in my breakouts areas and helps leaving my skin neutralized so when it comes time to putting my makeup on it's I don't have to use nearly as much product. The packaging is by far my favorite it's not to big and not to small and it fits very well with travel size products as well.
I don't really notice this product doing anything for me. I use the azeliac cream and that is really good. This one doesn't do much for me personally. Not bad not good.
Very pleased with my purchase. Has a nice cooling effect and has definitely helped my redness on my cheeks.

I have just started using this serum but am hopeful for the results! The price was reasonable and it has been super gentle on my skin so far. I have a pretty serve redness problem so I'm not seeing solutions yet! But I am seeing some minor improvements

avis.titre: This helped my skin barrier SO MUCH!
avis.texte: My skin was struggling with redness, burning and dryness. This line helped my skin within a week!
I was just about to repurchase this one, this serum with the amazing trio has been helping me reduce redness and breakouts on my skin, im ordering right now!
Very soothing and doesn't sting my skin after applying. Glad I got this
Delightful. I put on before the calming cream. With them both it makes my skin moisturizer enough for my spf to absorb.
I've been using this for a couple weeks and can already see a significant difference in the redness on my cheeks. I love this stuff!

This caused me to break out immediately. I stopped using it, healed, and tried again - 8 pimples the next morning. (I never get pimples!) I am only using Peach and Lily products, so it shouldn't be a cross reaction. Very sad because I think it does help with the redness.
It feel refreshing. It scanned a 100/100 on the carrot app as well!
Worked wonders on my sons acne prone oily skin and dulled the redness from acne scars!
I love the Redness Relief Soothing Serum. I use it every day and have notice a difference in my skin. I have rosacea and it helps calm my skin and does not cause any irritation.
I haven't noticed a big difference in redness - I still use it but not my favorite for redness

I've been dealing with rosacea symptoms and redness for years, I've tried so many products t's on the market and this is by far the best!! So lightweight and soothing on the skin and drastically improves my rosacea symptoms
It's so hydrating and soothing on the skin, my skin definitely looks less red and irritated after use, especially when paired with the azelaic acid serum Recommend!
Applies like a dream; however, I did not notice any change in my skin upon application or over time (I used the whole bottle)

I have roscea and very sensitive skin and this calms its down alot. I still have a bit of redness but i will take it. Ive gotten better results from this product than the calming cream that ive tried from this brand. A little goes a long way!

This is something that I have purchased once already and repurchased. I use it morning and night with a few other serums and it has seemed to calm my skin since I got it the first time. It's definitely something I plan to repurchase again.

This serum that is supposed to calm redness, did just the opposite and so much more. After using for a week, my skin is wrecked. I have sensitive skin that reacts to anything and everything I put on it, but never this bad. I wanted it to work, I was hoping it would help my constant red face! I will be returning this and the cleanser as well, as it didn't make my face clean or help with redness either. I hope I can add a photo to review. :(
I got this for help with my rosacea, it helps, and feels so nice. Makes my skin glow.

I was skeptical about this serum because I've used redness reducing products before and they always have a green tint and just seem to cover up not treat. This serum is smooth and as the day goes on after I use this my skin seems to get softer. I have rosacea and very sensitive skin in general and this doesn't irritate at all. I like to layer it with another serum and use the other products in the line in conjunction. I used to have a red spot on the end of my nose that's now almost gone after using these products.

I have dry, sensitive skin. I have always had redness due to mild rosacea and dryness. I have to say in just a couple days of using this I have noticed a big difference in the tones on my face. I'm not a fan of the consistency but not a big deal for me. I put it on AM and PM.
This product is amazing. I have rosacea on my face this helps alot. I put it on in the morning when i wake up and at night before i go to bed
I noticed a significant difference in the iverall complexity of my face. I felt like the redness disappeared shortly after using it. Recommend recommend recommend!!
This is the only thing that I have found that clears the redness on my face!
This product really does work. My main issue is redness from my acne, when I apply this serum the redness improves and seems to soothe my skin. I will continue to use this product.
This product helped greatly. I don't recommend putting it on before a full face of makeup because it's a little oily after a little bit. Other than that it's wonderful.
Huge noticeable difference in my skin tones upon using this. Will continue to purchase this product
Very good, lightweight serum for calming any redness. Perfect for that annoying painful breakout or for people with rosacea.
This lightweight serum calms redness after first application! Lightweight and layers well under other products
The peach slices, redness, relief, soothing serum with panthenol really does what it claims to do. Skin feels softer hydrated, and soothes irritation. This is great for sensitive skin.
I really enjoy using this serum as part of my nighttime skin care routine. It hydrates soothe and comforts my skin.
I love every product from this line. Seriously helps with redness!

i don't know if it's working or not but it instantly burned my skin. my nose and sides of mouth have a lot of redness from allergies and i think this actually made it worse. even if it does work, i don't think it's worth the irritation :(

I noticed a huge difference in the complexion of my skin. It did in fact reduce redness on my face and i've noticed that my blemishes are beginning to fade away. I absolutely love this product. Also, I did not have a problem with burning.
My rosacea was the worst it's ever been. I started using about 1.5 pumps of this at morning and at night. The redness and flare up has gone down and it's only been 5 days.

I was having a reaction to a product I used previously that left me with redness, dry and scaly skin all over my face and especially around my nose. I've been using this for around a week along with the calming cream. My skin was almost completely better overnight! So far, so good and will continue to use.

I had never heard of this brand but it caught my eye while in the store. I have always had red/rosacea cheeks and really like the Dr Jart Cica line to cover redness buuuut it all makes me soooo greasy. Put this on as soon as I got home and it was so soothing and I did see a difference right away. I have no idea if it'll last but it felt great. I definitely going back to get more redness relief products from this brand.

I have extremely sensitive skin & it's always red/irritated so I got excited to try this serum! Unfortunately after trying it for the first time last night I woke up with my cheeks burning & some new acne that wasn't there the night before. i'm gonna give it another try but the burning is super uncomfortable):

Unfortunately after trying it for the first time last night I woke up with my cheeks burning & some new acne that wasn't there the night before. i'm gonna give it another try but the burning is super uncomfortable):

I have dry, dehydrated, acne-prone skin that is prone to sensitivity, irritation, and redness. It's hard to find a balance between actives that help my acne but don't irritate my skin, and because of that, I recently damaged my skin barrier. I cut products from my routine and began using this hoping that it would help calm my skin. It's a slow process to heal my barrier, but I definitely think it's getting better. My only complaint is that I wish it was a little more hydrating, but that's probably just because my skin is so dry; probably great for other skin types. Still consider it a win because not only did it not irritate my already compromised skin, I think it's helping to heal it.

I have tried PLENTY of serums before and this is one has quickly become a top favorite. It has a running consistency and I find it to be very hydrating and it sinks in rather quickly. The finish is silky, not sticky and feels very calming. 10/10/!

I love this product. I officially have everything from the redness relief line and I cannot get enough of it! I think this will be replacing my snail serum because this bottle comes with a pump and the product helps to moisturize my skin and give a glass skin effect. I don't feel any burning from this product as mention from the previous post, it calms my skin for sure. Now peach slices just needs to start a Vitamin C Line and I'm all set, can't get enough of their products!
